results.overviewTitle.context: Scientific Results: Your flight, your evidence

results.noObjective.context: Scientific Results: No research objective was recorded.

results.observations.context: Scientific Results: Original in-flight measurement values

results.modeledOnly.context: Scientific Results: Modeled sensor support; not measured terrain or laser coverage.

results.terrainCells.context: Scientific Results: Source-backed DEM / DSM cells

results.historicalCells.context: Scientific Results: Valid retained native cells in the latest product. Gaps remain missing.

results.historicalReturns.context: Scientific Results: Original historical source records, not returns generated by the simulated aircraft.

results.separate.context: Scientific Results: Flight observations, modeled support, historical elevation cells and historical LiDAR returns are separate evidence. Post-flight products do not increase science yield or complete research cards.

results.noInstruments.context: Scientific Results: No saved instrument measurements.

results.exploreData.context: Scientific Results: Explore retained survey data

results.noProducts.context: Scientific Results: No supported post-flight product is retained. Original observations and advanced analysis remain available below. Preparing source support is an explicit separate action.

results.allSessions.context: Scientific Results: All recorded sessions (identities retained)

results.originalArtifact.context: Scientific Results: Open verified artifact JSON

results.identity.context: Scientific Results: Native cell / original record

results.legendScope.context: Scientific Results: Scale for this loaded source only. Transparent gaps are not inferred terrain. Source reference is independent of aircraft MSL.

results.retainedValues.context: Scientific Results: valid records retained in this product

results.endPages.context: Scientific Results: End of selected pages. Counts are not a claim of complete coverage.

results.morePages.context: Scientific Results: More retained pages available. Unloaded detail remains undisplayed.

results.gapsLayer.context: Scientific Results: Known nodata / excluded cell edges

results.originalsLayer.context: Scientific Results: Original acquisition footprints (modeled outlines)

results.nextPage.context: Scientific Results: Load next retained page

results.viewWindow.context: Scientific Results: Load detail in current map window

results.geometryBound.context: Scientific Results: Map outlines are bounded to the first 256 retained records. Inspect the original corridor artifact for the complete geometry.

results.gaps.context: Scientific Results: Modeled support gaps and collection boundaries

results.trackBound.context: Scientific Results: Track display is bounded to 8,192 archived valid poses; no path is extrapolated beyond this page.

results.originalBound.context: Scientific Results: Only the first 100 original acquisition outlines are loaded. Open the original science map to browse every acquisition.

results.invalidated.context: Scientific Results: Retained evidence is unavailable or changed. Displayed numerical data was cleared; original observations remain separately available.

results.advanced.context: Scientific Results: All instruments and advanced analysis

results.originalMap.context: Scientific Results: Original observations, imagery and native grids

results.provenance.context: Scientific Results: Source lineage, algorithms and limitations

results.cloudTitle.context: Scientific Results: Historical LiDAR — 3D point view

results.cloudKeys.context: Scientific Results: Historical LiDAR point view. Drag to orbit; Shift-drag to pan; arrows orbit; plus and minus zoom; Enter inspects the first visible record. All points are also available in the evidence table.

results.gpuFallback.context: Scientific Results: 3D rendering is unavailable. The 2D map and keyboard-accessible evidence table below remain usable; no records were replaced.

results.exaggeration.context: Scientific Results: Vertical display exaggeration (not original elevation)

results.localOrigin.context: Scientific Results: Local rendering origin; original coordinates remain in Evidence:

results.metricDisplay.context: Scientific Results: Z display converts documented feet to metres, without a vertical datum conversion.

results.unknownAspect.context: Scientific Results: Z units are unknown. Vertical display range is normalized to one quarter of the horizontal range; aspect is illustrative, not a metric height comparison.

results.geographicDisplay.context: Scientific Results: Geographic XY uses a local tangent approximation for display only.

results.nativeDisplay.context: Scientific Results: XY uses the original projected coordinate differences; projection scale distortion remains.

results.renderedPoints.context: Scientific Results: actual source records drawn

results.filteredPoints.context: Scientific Results: loaded records match filters

results.lod.context: Scientific Results: View-dependent representatives are actual records, never interpolated points or filled coverage. Zoom for more loaded detail.

results.elevation.context: Scientific Results: Original source elevation / Z

results.rgb.context: Scientific Results: Original RGB (16-bit display scale)

results.noCompatibleHeight.context: Scientific Results: No verified common terrain/point vertical reference for HAG

results.attributeAbsent.context: Scientific Results: Attribute absent from this original source

results.pointLimits.context: Scientific Results: Sparse points remain sparse. Source Z/date/datum may be unknown. RGB uses the original 16-bit channels. HAG is unavailable without proven compatible terrain. COPC access remains unsupported.

results.historicalLayer.context: Scientific Results: Historical LiDAR point locations

results.budgetLimit.context: Scientific Results: Viewer memory limit reached. Narrow the map window or choose another source; this display is a subset.
